title: A Hybrid Approach for Automated Security Pattern Recovery
abstract: arXiv:2611.05823v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Security-by-design emphasises integrating security into software design and development. Security pattern catalogues operationalise this principle by prescribing reusable architectural solutions to recurring security problems. However, recovering their implementations from source code remains challenging because security patterns are abstract, span multiple components, and admit many valid implementations. We present SecPatRec, a hybrid approach for automated security pattern recovery from source code repositories. We treat a security pattern as a reference architecture and frame its recovery as a deductive task: determining which prescribed roles are present, grounding them in code entities, and recovering their interaction sequences. SecPatRec pairs a ReAct-style LLM agent equipped with semantic and lexical code search for role detection and grounding with static code property graph analysis for interaction recovery. translated_title: 一种用于自动化安全模式恢复的混合方法
translated_abstract: 安全设计强调将安全融入软件设计与开发过程中。安全模式目录通过为反复出现的安全问题规定可复用的架构解决方案，将这一原则付诸实践。然而，从源代码中恢复安全模式的实现仍然具有挑战性，因为安全模式是抽象的、跨越多个组件，并且允许多种有效的实现方式。我们提出了SecPatRec，这是一种从源代码仓库中自动恢复安全模式的混合方法。我们将安全模式视为一种参考架构，并将其恢复任务构建为一个演绎任务：确定哪些规定角色存在、将这些角色落地到具体代码实体中，并恢复它们的交互序列。SecPatRec将一个配备语义和词汇代码搜索能力的ReAct风格LLM智能体（用于角色检测与落地）与静态代码属性图分析（用于交互恢复）相结合。我们构建了一个由人工标注的（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出SecPatRec，一种将ReAct风格LLM智能体与静态代码属性图分析相结合的混合方法，实现了从源代码仓库中自动恢复安全模式的角色检测、代码落地与交互序列识别。
en_tdlr: SecPatRec, a hybrid approach pairing a ReAct-style LLM agent with static code property graph analysis, enables automated recovery of security pattern roles, their grounding in code entities, and interaction sequences from source code repositories.
